title: Cute but thin
text: Cute but thin. This is a very cute blanket, and nice and soft. However, it is much thinner than I thought it would be. If you run cold in the winter this probably isn’t the throw for you. I expected it to be at least twice the thickness it is.

product_metadata.title: Velvet Touch Holiday Throw Fleece Blanket (50" x 60") - Reindeer
features: Add a touch of warmth to your home with this whimsical winter holiday themed ultra soft microplush throw blanket! Great for your throw for your couch or bed.

Blanket measures 50" x 60" just the right size for watching TV, reading, snuggling, as a play mat on the ground, or as a throw blanket on the couch enjoying family time. Large enough for most from kids, toddlers, teens even adults.

Micro plush Christmas/Winter blanket is 100% polyester fabric which is strong, durable, lightweight and resistant to shrinking and wrinkling. Perfect to keep you warm on a cold night. Soft plush blanket that stays the same as new after washing.
This Christmas throw blanket is machine washable in cold water, low temperature drying, easy care for blanket. Avoid direct heat. Do not use bleach.

Throw blankets makes a perfect gift for your child, friend, niece, nephew, grandson or granddaughter. For housewarming, Christmas, hostess gift, or to use for yourself. A thoughtful gift that will be a hit.
description: Bring the festive holidays to your home with this ultra soft fleece throw blanket. Measuring at 50" x 60", this holiday Fleece Throw will allow you to relax and unwind under its warm and comfort. Simply kick back on your couch, bed, sofa or chair and cuddle in on the ultra-soft cozy blankets. Purposefully light weight to meet your traveling needs. Stow it away in your backpack or luggage for ultimate comfort in a car, bus or plane. Perfect for snuggling with family while enjoying a hot cup of coffee or hot cocoa and watching television. Ultra soft material and elegant colors bring a calm and elegant touch to any room.
